primary.title: On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem
primary.author: Alan Turing
primary.rationale: This seminal paper introduced the Turing machine, a foundational concept in theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence. It is a primary source directly from Turing's work.

primary.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
primary.author: Alan Turing
primary.rationale: This influential paper introduced the Turing Test, a criterion for assessing a machine's ability to exhibit intelligent behavior equivalent to, or indistinguishable from, that of a human. It is a key primary source.

primary.title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
primary.author: Alan Turing
primary.rationale: This paper, published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society, outlines Turing's theory of biological pattern formation, demonstrating his broad scientific interests beyond computation. It is a primary source.

secondary.title: Alan Turing: The Enigma
secondary.author: Andrew Hodges
secondary.rationale: This is widely considered the definitive biography of Alan Turing, offering a comprehensive and scholarly account of his life and work. It is a highly regarded academic book.

secondary.title: Turing's Cathedral: The Origins of the Digital Universe
secondary.author: George Dyson
secondary.rationale: This book explores the intellectual history of the digital age, with a significant focus on Alan Turing's contributions and the development of early computing at the Institute for Advanced Study.

secondary.title: The Essential Turing: Seminal Writings in Computing, Logic, Philosophy, Artificial Intelligence, and Artificial Life Plus Extensive Historical Material
secondary.author: B. Jack Copeland
secondary.rationale: Edited by a leading Turing scholar, this collection provides access to many of Turing's key writings along with extensive scholarly commentary and historical context.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are foundational academic papers. Secondary sources are major biographies and scholarly analyses of Turing's life and work.
